scientific_integrity.assumptions: Fixed nonempty finite union of closed circular arcs with positive lengths and positive separating gaps; normalized spectral indicator; proper stationary centered complex Gaussian coefficients.
scientific_integrity.claim_scope: Exact sharp endpoint-count coefficient for the logarithmic term, bounded remainder, and compact-uniform local hard-edge zero-intensity profile.
scientific_integrity.evidence: Analytical proof by Poisson kernel expansion, integrated logarithmic derivative and harmonic edge scaling; independent numerical checker passes 169 assertions but is not an infinite proof.
scientific_integrity.limitations: No uniformity as endpoints merge, no arbitrary edge weights, no almost-sure counting or zero correlations. Prior work on the same half-circle mask is explicitly compared; historical priority remains uncertain.

title: Universal endpoint logarithms for zeros of band-limited stationary Gaussian analytic functions
